stepFast.$description: Quick: time for the crane to fetch, place and return for one block.

stepDuration.$description: Default time for the crane to fetch, place and return for one block.

stepSlow.$description: Relaxed: time for the crane to fetch, place and return for one block.

headroom.$description: Space above the page reserved for the crane's jib and trolley.

jibHeight.$description: Thickness of the crane's horizontal jib.

mastWidth.$description: Width of the crane's vertical mast.

trolleyWidth.$description: Width of the trolley that runs along the jib.

hookSize.$description: Size of the hook block at the end of the rope.

raisedRope.$description: Rope length while the hook is raised.

dustSize.$description: Size of the dust puffs when a block lands.

settleDuration.$description: A block's small squash as it lands, and its dust puff.

exitDuration.$description: The crane lifting away, and placeholders turning into the page, when loading finishes.

shimmerDuration.$description: Placeholder shimmer while the page is built but still loading.
